title: ElevenLabs now lets users publish AI-generated music directly on SoundCloud
slides: ElevenLabs music on SoundCloud: what changes for creators?
The tool now integrates directly with SoundCloud's upload system.
But copyright and royalty rules remain unclear for AI tracks.
You can publish AI music today, but platforms may still flag it.
Test one track this week and check how it's received.
thread_text:
1. SoundCloud Opens AI Music

ElevenLabs tracks can now be uploaded directly to SoundCloud. Creators can publish AI-generated music today, but platform flags may still catch it.

2. Upload Straight From ElevenLabs

The tool integrates with SoundCloud's upload system, so you can move from prompt to published track without leaving the interface.

3. Copyright Rules Still Unclear

Royalty splits and ownership for AI tracks remain undefined. Platforms haven't settled on how to handle AI-generated content.

4. Platforms May Flag Your Track

Even with direct upload, automated systems can still flag AI music. You might publish successfully and still face removal later.

5. Test One Track This Week

Upload a single AI track and watch how it's received. Does it get flagged, ignored, or played? That answer tells you more than any policy page.

instagram.caption:
You can now publish an AI-generated track to SoundCloud without leaving ElevenLabs — prompt to live upload in one flow.

The tool plugs straight into SoundCloud's upload system. 🎛️

But royalty splits and ownership for AI music are still undefined, and automated systems can flag your track even after it goes live.

So your release might play today and disappear next week, with no clear rule telling you why. 🚩

If you make music, test one track this week and watch what happens: flagged, ignored, or played? 🎧

Would you risk releasing a track you can't fully own?
